learning_outcomes.text: confront him/herself in a personal and critical way with the topic of the course.
argue his/her position, showing that he/she is conscious of the complexity of the questions at stake, also when confronted with various philosophical and religious traditions.
clarify the fundamental categories of reflection on ethics and to show how these notions stand out when confronted with the experience of faith and with Christian reflection.

syllabus_topics: Basic principles of ethical reflection and its relationship to the Christian faith
Concepts such as freedom, conscience, human person
Various ethical approaches to assess situations where individuals are confronted with conflicts of values and that require ethical reflection
Making an ethical decision in a plural world, being open to different religious, cultural and social positions, to avoid adopting a moralizing and unilateral discourse
bibliography: A bibliography will be made available to students on the Moodle platform.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
